prompt: What is the name of the hotel that features over 7,000 rooms and one of the biggest casino gaming floors on the Las Vegas strip?
answer: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas—the combined Venetian and Palazzo complex. It has more than 7,000 suites and one of the largest casino gaming areas on the Las Vegas Strip.
